name: diagnosing-bugs
description: 6-phase disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions: build a tight red-capable feedback loop first, reproduce and minimise, rank 3-5 falsifiable hypotheses, instrument with [DEBUG-xxxx] probes, lock down a seam regression test, and clean up.
suggestedPrompts: Diagnose this failing behavior by building a tight red-capable feedback loop first
Debug this intermittent flake and raise its reproduction rate before hypothesising
Diagnose this performance regression with a baseline timing harness and bisection
